enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running to cope with the warm weather
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull sheet. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust fan speed. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull sheet up. Breathe deeply. Remain sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, and taking a quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, checking the heatwave warning on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait. Take phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Read heatwave warning. Take toast out of toaster. Butter toast. Eat toast. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light clothing, packing a work bag and water bottle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select light shirt. Select light pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take water bottle. Walk to kitchen. Fill water bottle. Walk back to bedroom. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place notebook in backpack. Place pen in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office during the morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleague. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Send email. Pick up phone. Call partner organization. Speak on phone. Hang up. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Discuss program. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Open program schedule. Update schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in an air-conditioned cafe near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Approach counter. Order sandwich. Pay. Wait. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Stand up. Leave cafe.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at the office: planning upcoming community events and updating program schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open calendar. Plan event. Call venue. Send email. Update schedule. Meet with colleague. Discuss event details. Take notes. Send follow-up email. Print schedule. Review schedule. Make phone call. Hang up. Update spreadsheet. Save file.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from work in the late afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and freshening up after a hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the air conditioner on, watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust air conditioner temperature. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, laying out clothes for tomorrow and turning on the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select clothes. Lay clothes on chair. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for ventilation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull sheet. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Remain sleeping.
